build_dataset_builder: build a GTZANMusicSpeech dataset builder that downloads and extracts 120 wav tracks for music/speech classification
create_dataset_info: create dataset info with audio features at 22050Hz sample rate and binary music/speech class labels
generate_dataset_examples: generate dataset examples by walking wav files and extracting label from directory names using regex
split_dataset_train: split the dataset into a single TRAIN split with no predefined validation or test sets
review_GTZANMusicSpeech_class: review the GTZANMusicSpeech class and its GeneratorBasedBuilder methods for music/speech discrimination
